notes.title: [UPDATE] A Scavenger's Tale - Part II
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/6d3ec4b5cf5433db9ff5b07b72dc239d4805c8c6.png[/img]

Dear Florensians,

As you know, a wise bard recently uncovered an ancient tale on his journey through Florensia. He spoke of a dark evil, a terrible magic that no one had dared wield until now. If you believe his words, a young magician made a pact with a demon to gain unimaginable power. It is said that his heart is filled with hate and his only goal is to destroy Florensia once and for all. Furthermore, he will not stop until the deed is done. How could Florensia stand against such evil?

After hearing this chilling tale, the adventurers searched for the bard to ask for more information. They were desperate for anything that might help them fight against the magician and his terrible army that they had been told about.

They finally found him in a nearby tavern. The bard listened to their requests and, leaning heavily on his wooden staff, he answered slowly:

"It is said, that for every spell cast nature seeks a balance. To cast a spell so dark and terrible that it could destroy all of Florensia, the magician will have no choice but to create certain anchor points. These will draw the magic focus and connect to cause pure destruction. Everyone who has learned the magical arts knows this. For the release of such a large amount of dark energy, nature will also create light in the darkness, and so bring balance to the world. I cannot tell you for sure what will happen. When it comes to magic, nothing is ever certain. But I am positive the light will give you a way to defeat evil. An adventurer brave enough to stand against such evil will find a way to fight. Of course, he will have to enter the magician's realm and no one knows where that may be...so I cannot deny I am worried. But the only chance we have is you."

Your Florensia Team

notes.title: [UPDATE] A Scavenger's Tale - Part I
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/6d3ec4b5cf5433db9ff5b07b72dc239d4805c8c6.png[/img]

Dear Florensians,

A long-forgotten tale has recently come to light. It was passed down through the generations and told in hushed voices, for fear it could be overheard, since it is a dark and mysterious tale indeed.

Now it came to pass that a wise bard passed through Florensia. He claimed to have extremely important news. One night, many curious adventurer gathered around a bonfire so the bard could tell them of this ancient tale, for he was one of the few who knew about it. He lowered his voice and spoke in a hushed whisper:

"Once there was a dark wizard who was feared everywhere. He was the descendant of an ancient clan that did not want to bow before the laws of Florensia. This brought about a war between the magicians and the humans which resulted in the magicians being wiped out, since they were not powerful enough to face Florensia's army of skilled warriors. Peace returned and everything seemed well.

However, hidden in the shadows, one boy survived, with magical abilities of his own. The rage and grief of losing his family enhanced his powers and he vowed to one day take revenge on the humans who had destroyed his clan. Legend has it that he entered a pact with a demon to gain forbidden black magic. His soul was consumed by the dark force of the demon and fed with anger. The mage resurrected his own hateful army from the bare ground which had remained of his country after the war.

Now he will stop at nothing to destroy Florensia and its inhabitants once and for all."

After the bard had finished his chilling tale, the adventurers looked at each other across the bonfire in sudden fear. Which of them would dare stand against such pure evil?

Your Florensia Team

Dear Florensians,

Our Screenshot Contest has come to an end and we are proud to present the winners! We are overwhelmed by all the great entries that we received from you. There were so many unique screenshot ideas you didn't make the choice easy for us. Nevertheless, here are the two entries that we were most impressed with! The winners will receive their prize of 10.000 AP by the following week.

Furthermore, all screenshot entries will receive 1x 7-day-headphones per person. Since there were so many great entries, we will show you some more over the next weeks. Thank you all for your participation and we can't wait for the next contest!

NOTE: Don't forget to send us your e-mail and name of the Florensia Account you want us to send your prize to.


WINNER OF BEST SCREENSHOT

This image has such a unique angle and choice of picture section that we had to give it an award for showing the spirit of Florensia perfectly. A bright blue sky, nice costumes and two curious explorers who can't wait to see what's going on in Florensia. Congratulations to the winner :)

Your Florensia Team

Dear Florensians,

You have always dreamed of actively shaping Florensia and seeing your ideas come to life? Take your chance now and take part in our Design Your Dress competition!

Be inspired by your favourite costumes or create a completely new look that we have never seen before! Wedding Gowns, Royal Costumes, Sinister Dark Outfits, Cute Animal Dresses or Shiny Armour...it's completely up to you! We can't wait to see what you come up with!

After the contest deadline, your designs will be posted for the community to vote on. The design with the most votes from the community will be used as a template to make a new costume for Florensia and will be available in our item shop! This is the opportunity for you to have explorers all across Florensia wear your design!

There are some details about your submission that are important:

- Only one submission per person is permitted

- The submission must be your own design

- Send us your designs with a picture size of at least 1200x720px

- Your Design should include a back and front view.

- Your e-mail size shouldn't be more than 16MB

- Please send us your sketch to flocontest@gamesinflames.com

- The deadline is the 30th of April 2017

We are very excited to see what inspirational ideas our amazing Florensia community will come up with! Have fun!

Your Florensia Team

During their exploration of the tombs, the adventurers also discovered the long-forgotten tomb of pharao Tutankhamun. notes.title: [PATCHLOG] 16.02.2017
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/5daa9eabab15c538676093ee3727aa01ae8095b6.png[/img]

Dear Florensians,

We are excited to see what you make of our new Avery Elite Dungeon and its monsters! We have written the following patchlog to give you more detailed information on the quests you will have to fulfill and the monsters you will encounter in the Avery Elite Dungeon! Have fun and most of all...be brave!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/6e605e1b0fcc80275f0e22ea09010cb184b32ef0.jpg[/img]

[b]Monsters[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/e7aca9416a3cd9912ecabb9e0cfc325ada90a3b6.jpg[/img]

[b]Items[/b]

There is a variety of great items you will find in the Avery Elite Dungeon! These include CC items, upgrade items and pet items!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/350dbfecec46e330d16596c55181ee8f051e8eb9.jpg[/img]

[b]Quests[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/498a4c5aeeeb123dbd53a6075376300ea3ad50d5.jpg[/img]

[b]Note[/b]: Some of the quests are repeatable. The quests are connected with each other as a quest series, so every adventurer needs to begin with the first quest - "Frederic's Test" - and work there way through the other quests one by one. It will be challenging and we cannot wait to hear how you all will face this adventure!


[b]Balance Update[/b]

We changed the skill of Shade of Fear, that it now have a chance to miss.

Your Florensia Team

notes.title: [SHOP] Ice Ice Baby
notes.notes:
Dear Florensians,

Matching the winterly temperature we would like to present the icy accessories of the Frost Giant Ymir!

The germanic mythology teaches us, that at the beginning of all time there was a place of fire, Muspbell, and a place of ice, Nilfheim. Between them there only existed a large divide, the so-called Ginnungagap. Here it came to pass that the nordic ice met the southern fire and from the melted ice water arose the Frost Giant Ymir. From his body our world was created - sky, earth, water, mountain and forest. As legend has it, Ymir's skull became the sky, his body the earth and his blood the sea.

The power of Ymir is now bound to his ring, his necklace and his earring. Get your icy accessories now and carry Ymir's soul with you on your adventures!

In addition, the bundles are reduced up to 25%.

Your

notes.title: Steam game language Settings
notes.notes:
Hello Florensians,

For those who are unfamiliar with Steam's game language settings here a small guide on how to change the Florensia game language:

1. Log into your Steam account
2. Right click on Florensia in the Steam game library and choose Properties.
3. Go to the Language tab
4. Select the language you wish to use from the drop-down menu
5. Click OK

For more information on Steam language settings also see https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=8487-WSCN-4121

notes.title: Steam Guide
notes.notes:
Dear Florensians,

We’ve made it! Florensia is coming to Steam! There is going to be some maintenance tomorrow, 29.11.16 from 6 am CET. 
As soon as maintenance is complete, you will be able to play the game by following these steps:

1.) Install the game on Steam and launch it.

2.) When you first launch the game you either need to open a new Florensia account the first time you log in...

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/a6aacaaff50f105b1a539a6575f96d37f50f11e0.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/eca58b60b9a881fedc3465eaf745430ee7ebbcb3.jpg[/img]

...or link an existing Florensia account.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/524dafae4f75fb1e6ec1e6e84f4239a6be8c54e4.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/864759cb692072f90a504a49b470089438d0c53e.jpg[/img]

3.) After creating or linking an account restart the client. After doing this once you will be logged in automatically in future.

4.) You are not obliged to use Steam. It is merely a different way of logging into Florensia. You can use your regular Florensia account to log in.

5.) You can authorize payments through Steam by logging into Steam and using the link in the Florensia shop in-game to charge your AP (Aurum Pieces). This will launch the Internet Explorer, which therefore has to be installed beforehand.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/fd0325f585ea6a81707a963d5429ee22ecaa1689.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/d052f00361e8f796b84473806046b3370b00eceb.jpg[/img]

Have fun exploring and we'll see you in-game!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/5ea782741abf55b76f91983ec76942ee9cb38412.png[/img]

notes.notes:

notes.title: Steam Release in November!
notes.notes:
Sorry for the long delay but it took a lot longer than we thought to update the game so that it works with Steam.

We had the first approval round and have to change some minor things and than we can finally release it. Exact date will follow.

We work on new content as well which got delayed due to the Steam work but we have nice things to come.

See you ingame!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25229855/a6692c9c09113dcd36c898c3b52b79241e863d68.png[/img]

*Edit*

Due to a minor issue sadly the approvals failed. We have already solved and re-submitted. So a release should happen soon.
